abstract: We found similar levels of thromboplastic activity in molar tissue, vesicular fluid and normal placental tissue from pregnancies matched for gestational age. The fibrinolytic activity of molar tissue and vesicular fluid was, however, increased and vaginal haemorrhage tended to be heavier when fibrinolytic activity was high (p = 0.06). Subsequent choriocarcinoma occurred more frequently in patients with molar tissue which had low fibrinolytic activity (p = 0.08).
abstract_ja: 妊娠週数を揃えた正常胎盤、胞状奇胎組織、嚢胞液において、組織トロンボプラスチン活性は同程度であった。一方、奇胎組織と嚢胞液の線溶活性は増加していた。線溶活性が高い場合には膣出血が多い傾向があった(p = 0.06)。その後に絨毛癌を発症したのは、線溶活性の低い奇胎組織を有する患者で多かった(p = 0.08)。
